# FrameClock

> **Kind:** context · **Registry:** host · **Folder:** [`src/logic/components/`](../folders/src-logic-components.md)
> **Source:** [`src/logic/components/frame_clock.h`](../../../src/logic/components/frame_clock.h)

## Summary

Frame delta, accumulated time and frame number of the dynamical frame loop.

## Description

Host context variable emplaced in the Game constructor (src/view/game.cpp) and advanced by the frame loop before the systems tick (dt, time += dt, frame++). With RunArgs::fixed_frame_dt, dt is fixed and time = frame * dt, so nothing reads the wall clock. Read by the Renderer (shader time) and capture/probe code.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |

| `dt` | `double` | 0 | seconds of this frame |
| `time` | `double` | 0 | seconds since start |
| `frame` | `uint64_t` | 0 | 1 for the first frame |
